sloka: त्वया दत्तो ऽयमस्माकमायुषः पवनः पतिः ।सो ऽस्मान्प्राणेश्वरो भूत्वा कस्मादेषो ऽद्य सत्तम ।। ७.३५.५५ ॥
transliteration: tvayā datto 'yamasmākamāyuṣaḥ pavanaḥ patiḥ ।so 'smānprāṇeśvaro bhūtvā kasmādeṣo 'dya sattama ।। 7.35.55 ॥

translations.english: "This Vayu, the lord of our life, was given to us by you; why then, O best among the good, has he, having become the lord of our very breath, acted thus today?"
